Deep Forest.name: Deep Forest
Deep Forest.summary: Something seems odd when you can't find your faithful friend Squee in the morning. The forest is ill and you'll need your squirrel friend's help to save the animal spirits. Use your witchy powers to discover the true cause of this turmoil and save the forest from its nightmare.

Mortal Kombat - Shinken Kourin Densetsu.name: Mortal Kombat
Mortal Kombat - Shinken Kourin Densetsu.summary: Game Boy port of Mortal Kombat.

Shock Lobster.name: Shock Lobster
Shock Lobster.summary:
Zip and zap your way to the top in this aquaventure!

Shock Lobster is a Game Boy ROM designed to run on the original Game Boy handheld video game system using a flash cartridge. It should also play well on most emulators.
